Business in Chisago County

Small towns, big reputations.

Chisago City, Lindstrom, Center City, North Branch and Taylors Falls are lake and river towns where a business can be known by everyone in town and invisible to everyone outside it.

Growing here usually means reaching past the county line, to people driving up from the cities or searching from the next town over. That takes a brand that can do the introducing, and it starts with deciding what you want to be known for.

Also working with businesses in Chisago City, Lindstrom, Center City, North Branch and Taylors Falls.

  • Known in town, invisible online

    Everyone here knows you. Someone searching from Forest Lake or the cities has to find you, and see the same business your neighbors do.

  • The safe choice, not the obvious one

    In a small town it is easy to become the default. Deliberate positioning makes you the first choice instead.

  • Pricing for the experience

    If what you offer is premium, the brand has to say so before the first appointment.

The Strategy Day

One day to decide.

For the business that needs a decision more than a build. We work through four things in order, and by the end of the day the hardest questions about your brand have answers, in writing.

  1. Audit

    What is working, what is not, and why: your website, your offers, your reviews and how you describe the business today.

  2. Discovery

    Who you serve best, who you want more of, and what they are choosing between when they find you.

  3. Positioning

    The one clear decision: who the business is for and what it should be known for.

  4. Message

    The words to say it, on your website, in a conversation and in a search result.

Questions

Before you book.

Something not here? Ask me directly. I answer every one myself.

Do you work with businesses in Chisago County?

Yes. Mane Alchemist Salon in Chisago is one of my full brand launches, and the county is a short drive from my base in Forest Lake. A Strategy Day can be in person or remote.

What did Mane Alchemist Salon get?

A Full Brand Launch: logo, brand guide and voice, a website, a 90-day social launch and quarterly content, all built from one positioning decision made first.

How much does a Strategy Day cost?

$1,500 flat. If you go on to a full brand launch like Mane Alchemist’s, that starts at $15,000, and websites start at $4,000.

Can I start with just the Strategy Day?

Yes. The day stands on its own: you leave with your positioning and message in writing, and then you decide what to build.
